answer: We deploy dynamic opportunity-cost bonds requiring staking collateral inside a cryptographic vault to deter identity multiplication. Integrating subgame-perfect slashing matrices with zero-knowledge verifiable delay guarantees that Sybil attacks at dawn incur severe slashing penalties, yielding strictly negative expected attack utility and refuting the fable of profitable forgery. This capital barrier compels rational adversaries to converge toward a robust Nash equilibrium, rendering multi-agent collusion economically irrational.
